subject: Sequence reset incident, evidence attached, and proposed grace-period credit
messages:
From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@finedge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: FinEdge Support <support@finedge.com>, procurement@finedge.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inference sequence resets causing 500s/timeouts — need confirmation for credit request

Marcus —

We observed a burst of failures this morning on our checkout path that map to requests served by your hosted endpoint (model: open-llama-13b-v1). From our telemetry the window of elevated 500s and client timeouts is approximately 07:58–08:15 PDT (UTC-7). The errors are predominantly "sequence_reset" followed by a small spike of 503s; tail latency jumped from our baseline ~70ms to >2s for many requests.

Impact: we had ~68 failed/errored requests and roughly 1.8k requests with latency above our 95th baseline during the 17-minute window. This affected checkout completion for some users and triggered an emergency rollback on our side.

We're opening a formal SLA claim per Section 3.2 of the MSA and would like:
- confirmation from Redwood on whether this qualifies as an SLA-eligible availability incident,
- the precise downtime/impact window as measured by your systems, and
- instructions for evidence we should provide (we've attached a small sample of error payloads).

Please advise next steps and whether you need a larger log bundle; procurement copied in case we need contract/credit paperwork.

Attachments: finedge-error-samples-20260910.txt (sample request/response rows)

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Director of Platform Reliability
FinEdge

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@finedge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 08:31:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inference sequence resets causing 500s/timeouts — need confirmation for credit request

Thanks for the heads up and for the sample payloads, Alyssa — really sorry for the impact. I copied Soojin (SRE), Ben (Support), and Grace (Customer Success) so we can coordinate evidence and an initial remediation path.

Quick notes / ask list so we can triage fast:
1) Can you confirm the customer request IDs for ~10 of the failed calls (request IDs are in your sample) so we can pull full traces?
2) Please also upload a compressed trace bundle if you can (we requested a trace upload link in the ticket, but the sample is fine to start).
3) Do you know if you were pinned to a specific model version or a variant with quantization changes this morning?

Initial internal plan: Soojin will reconcile our runtime logs against your request IDs and confirm whether a sequence reset was triggered in the runtime (KV cache eviction / unexpected token length reset). If we confirm an availability interruption that meets the SLA window, we'll calculate a provisional credit and share an evidence bundle.

We typically need the raw trace bundle and the request ID list to produce an authoritative impact window; if you can push that, we'll prioritize it. In the meantime, I'm flagging this as high priority for the SRE on-call.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

From: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@finedge.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: FinEdge Support <support@finedge.com>, procurement@finedge.com
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inference sequence resets causing 500s/timeouts — need confirmation for credit request

Thanks Marcus — attaching a larger bundle as requested. The bundle includes full request IDs and raw client-side traces for the affected timeframe. We also included our CDN timestamps to help reconcile time skew.

Attachment: redwood-trace-request-20260910.tar.gz (9.8 MB of gzipped JSON lines)

For your questions: we were pinned to open-llama-13b-v1@2026-08-22 (no custom quantization on our end). Sample request IDs attached in the bundle; 10 canonical IDs attached in the first file for easy lookup.

Please confirm when you've ingested the bundle and whether you'll be proposing a provisional credit while the postmortem is prepared.

Alyssa

> Marcus —
>
> We observed a burst of failures this morning ...

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Chen <alyssa@finedge.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Grace Oconnor <grace@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Sep 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Inference sequence resets causing 500s/timeouts — provisional credit and postmortem timeline

Alyssa — thank you for the bundle. We pulled the traces and reconciled them against our runtime telemetry. Below is the summary and next steps.

Summary (preliminary):
- Incident window we observe on Redwood serving plane: 2026-09-10T07:58:20Z -> 2026-09-10T08:16:45Z (UTC).
- Cause (initial): transient sequence KV reset triggered by a bug in the runtime's cache reconciliation path when a concurrent model reload raced with an active request. This manifests as sequence_reset errors followed by short-lived 503/500 responses while the kernel hot-swap completed.
- Impact on FinEdge: we match the 68 explicit request failures in your sample and see the elevated tail latency numbers in the same window.

Provisional remedy & credit: per Section 3.2 of the MSA, the incident meets the SLA availability threshold; we're proposing a provisional credit equal to 10% of that month's usage for the affected resource class, subject to formal verification. We'll finalize the exact dollar amount once we complete the postmortem and a full accounting (expected within 7 business days). If you need paperwork for procurement sooner, we can provide a stub credit memo to expedite reconciliation.

Postmortem/timeline:
- SRE deep-dive complete and initial RCA documented by 2026-09-14.
- Internal fix (race condition mitigation) scheduled for the 2026-09-20 runtime patch; can be backported to your dedicated pool if you prefer (we can discuss a maintenance window).
- Final evidence pack, credit calculation, and formal postmortem delivered by 2026-09-17.

Next steps we need from you:
- Confirm whether you'd like the patch backported to any pinned/dedicated capacity (yes/no).
- Confirm whether a stub credit memo helps procurement now.

We're treating this as high priority; apologies again for the customer impact. I'll follow up when the postmortem draft is ready and share the final credit calculation.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
